## Goal

Let an entitled subscriber read FULL analyses, and keep everyone else at LOCKED/DELAYED, with no leak.

## Context

`tipy/[slug]/page.tsx` always calls `tipDisclosure(tip, [], now)`. Entitlements are loadable via `src/lib/billing/entitlement-loader.ts` and `src/lib/auth/customer.ts`. FULL exists only in `visibility.ts`.

## Scope

- Resolve the current customer and entitlements server-side on the tip page and a new subscriber "Dnešní analýzy" view.
- Render FULL: selection, odds at publication, minimum odds, stake in units, rationale, sources.
- Ensure FULL data is never fetched for a non-entitled request (not just hidden).
- Correct caching: no shared cache of entitled responses; `generateMetadata` and OG never include paid fields.
- Account page shows plan, status, renewal or end date.

## Out of scope

- Checkout and cancellation UI (SC-014).
- Push notifications, API access, exports.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Anonymous and expired users: paid fields absent from HTML, RSC payload, metadata, sitemap, `llms.txt` (tests).
- [ ] Entitled user sees FULL.
- [ ] Codex review approves.

## Required tests

- Unit tests for the page-level disclosure call.
- DB test: entitlement grant on/off changes disclosure.
- Playwright leak test (SC-011).

## Dependencies

- SC-005
- SC-004

## Priority

P1 · Phase B
